paper.title: Instance-Dependent Complexity of Contextual Bandits and Reinforcement Learning: A Disagreement-Based Perspective

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic contextual bandit with realizable value function class (AdaCB upper bounds)
unmapped: learner has access to a weighted least-squares regression oracle for F; |F| denoted N_exp
settings.definition_quote: At each round $t\in\brk*{T}$, the learner observes a context $x_t\in\cX$, selects an action $a_t\in\cA$, then observes a reward $\ls_t(a_t)\in\brk*{0,1}$. We assume that contexts are drawn \iid from a fixed but unknown distribution $\xdist$ ... There exists a function $\fstar\in\cF$ such that $\fstar(x,a) = \En\brk*{\ls(a)\mid{}x}$.

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic contextual bandit, realizable class, Bernoulli rewards (lower bound)
settings.definition_quote: In fact, for our lower bound it suffices to only consider reward distributions $\bbP_r$ for which $r(a)$ is Bernoulli with mean $\fstar(x,a)$ given $x$

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic contextual bandit, realizable class, unit Gaussian rewards (star number lower bound)
settings.definition_quote: To avoid technical conditions involving the boundary of the interval $\brk*{0,1}$, we allow for unit Gaussian rewards with means in $\brk*{0,1}$ for this lower bound.

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandit with adversarial contexts, stochastic rewards, realizable class
unmapped: contexts chosen by an adaptive adversary; rewards r_t ~ P_r(.|x_t) stochastic given context
settings.definition_quote: In the adversarial context setting we allow the contexts $x_1,\ldots,x_T$ to be chosen by an adaptive adversary, but we still assume that $r_t\sim{}\rdist(\cdot\mid{}x_t)$ at each round.

settings.name_in_paper: Block MDP (episodic RL with rich observations)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Episodic reinforcement learning (block MDP), not a bandit problem.
unmapped: latent MDP with S latent states, decodability, optimistic completeness of value class
algorithm uses the number of latent states S and disagreement coefficient in confidence radii
settings.definition_quote: the block MDP setup we consider is a layered episodic Markov decision process with horizon $H$, state space $\cX=\cX_1\cup\cdots\cup\cX_H$ ... and action space $\cA$ with $\abs*{\cA}=A$.

source.label: thm:disagreement_ub
source.quote: For any instance with uniform gap $\Delta$, \pref{alg:main} with \optionone ensures that \En\brk{\Reg}=\bigoht(1)\cdot\min_{\varepsilon>0}\max\left\{\varepsilon\Delta T, \frac{\PolicyDis{\veps}{\K\log|\cF|}}{\Delta}\right\}+\bigoht(1).

results.notes: Bound is minimized over eps; eps_alg is that free parameter. No knowledge of Delta or theta needed. Regret defined vs pi*(x_t), expected → pseudo-regret. Additive O~(1) omitted. Implies minimax O~(sqrt(K T log|F|)) since theta <= 1/eps.

source.label: prop:tsybakov
source.quote: Suppose there exist constants $\alpha ,\beta\ge0$ such that \bbP_{\cD}\prn*{f^*(x,\pistar(x))-\max_{a\neq{}\pistar(x)}f^*(x,a)\le\gamma}\le\beta\gamma^{\alpha}.
